facts.statement: A spinning icon on the game screen gives players a chance to win a prize on the Daily Wheel; prizes include potions, treasure tickets, karts and pets.
facts.quote: Look for the spinning icon on your game screen for your chance to win a prize on the Daily Wheel!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: Update notes for the August 28, 2009 Free Realms patch, covering a Daily Wheel prize feature, Marketplace filtering, Sword Testing leaderboards, SC Kart repairs, a longer Troll Fort battle timer, whisper display fixes, friends-list status fixes, and a Cloudy With A Chance Of Meatballs costume change. The page gives no quest or item statistics beyond these notes.
